clips.title: The story
paras: Kobolds dig furiously for Resonite in Boulderslide Ravine, deep in the Stonetalon Mountains. From Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal sends Horde scouts into the caves for samples, troubled by a growing tension in the earth.

At Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal watches the Stonetalon peaks with concern. The earth feels disturbed, with an unnatural agitation rising from the southeast. In Boulderslide Ravine, kobolds have left their usual foraging to dig aggressively for Resonite, a rare mineral found beneath the surface. Mor'rogal sends Horde scouts past the kobolds and into the cave's deepest reaches to learn why they mine with such frenzy. He asks them to bring back raw samples.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, friend?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave. I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.
Go young adventurer, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.
Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.
Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this kobold plot.
